comment: Castle rooftops (docs/regioes/topo-do-castelo.md): rooms painted tile by tile with ts_CastleTop, written by tools/templates/make_rooms.py (roadmap F12b-1, the pilot and its review). The kit's pieces are cells of ALttP area 0x1B (the top of Hyrule Castle; col, row of 16x16 blocks, incoming/topo-do-castelo/tiles/areas.json): the teal roof terrace is the floor, the cream wall tops and the riveted beige faces are walls, as on the original. The walls go on past the edge of the room (no outer face, no wall end at the edge), so neighbouring rooms join; every corner is a whole cell of the area with its dark outline (Guilherme's review, oct/2026). A passage is a straight cut through the wall. The door sets are the fewest that cover every 1x1, 1x2 and 2x1 room the Castle layouts gave in 12 seeds (scenario castle_top_layouts): passages of neighbouring positions touch, so a 1x1 room takes no two neighbours on the ring 1..12. The gate of a top door is the level's entrance or exit (the palace door of the area, animated by the game); a bottom door's gate is the stairs down out of the front gate of the area, for an exit that cannot go in the top wall.

specials.comment: Every shared special room that fits is painted with the rooftops' frame (docs/design/direcao.md: special rooms match their area).

view_left.comment: The outer wall of the castle on the left: its riveted face drops to the grass and trees below (mirrored by the game for the right).

special.comment: The special rooms (shop, treasure, rupees, fairy...): the top wall one row lower, so their objects, laid out for the dungeon walls, keep clear of it.

view_bottom.comment: The outer wall of the castle at the bottom: its riveted face drops to the grass and bushes below.

parapet.comment: The low wall of a section (paint_sections.py): its rows are the bottom wall's top edge and the top wall's face, its columns the inner edges of the side walls.

painted.name: Terrace
painted.comment: Roof terrace between the castle walls, as in the preview approved by Guilherme (oct/2026): towers with green lamps either side of the top passage, the Hylian crest in the middle.

painted.name: Crossroads
painted.comment: Where the walkways of the four sides meet: the crest in the middle, towers either side of the top passage, bushes on the grass growing over the terrace between the walkways.

painted.name: TwinGates
painted.comment: Two passages through the top wall with a lamp tower between them.

painted.name: Rampart
painted.comment: A long stretch of parapet: passages near the corners, a tower in the middle of the top wall, a bare terrace.

painted.name: SideTower
painted.comment: A lamp tower beside the passage near the corner of the top wall, the crest in the middle. It was TowerGate, whose decorative gate looked like the level's exit; its doors leave no room for a mirrored pair of bushes.

painted.name: LampCourt
painted.comment: Lamp towers either side of the top passage over a bare terrace; side passages near the corners.

painted.name: LowGates
painted.comment: Two passages through the bottom wall, towers either side of the top one.

painted.name: Gatehouse
painted.comment: Passages on every side but the corners: the room of an exit moved to the top wall (position 12) beside a side passage near the top; towers either side of the top passage, the crest in the middle.

painted.name: Overlook
painted.comment: The outer wall of the castle on the left side: past its riveted face, the grass and trees down below (the game mirrors it for the right side). No passage on that side.

painted.name: LongTerrace
painted.comment: A terrace two rooms long with passages all along the sides; towers by the top passage, the crest in the middle.

painted.name: LongRampart
painted.comment: A long terrace with passages near the corners and along the sides; a tower in the middle of the top wall (its walkways leave no room for nature).

painted.name: LongOverlook
painted.comment: Two rooms long along the outer wall of the castle, the grass and trees down below on the left (mirrored for the right).

painted.name: WideTerrace
painted.comment: A terrace two rooms wide: three passages in the top and bottom walls, side passages in the middle; lamp towers between the top passages, the crest in the middle.

painted.name: WideGarden
painted.comment: A wide stretch of parapet with passages near the corners of the sides; towers between the top passages and bushes on the grass between the walkways. It was WideRampart, whose decorative gates looked like the level's exit.

painted.name: WideCourt
painted.comment: A wide court open to one side near the top and to the other in the middle; towers between the top passages, bushes on the grass.

painted.name: Grove
painted.comment: A wide terrace taken over by nature: a tree in each half on the grass growing over the floor, towers between the top passages. Few passages, so the trees have room (it serves the wide rooms with those doors only).

painted.name: WideOverlook
painted.comment: The outer wall of the castle at the bottom: past its riveted face, the grass and bushes down below. No passage in the bottom wall, nor low on the sides.

painted.name: OpenTerrace
painted.comment: A bare terrace open on every side: the room for door sets no other room has (picked only when none fits, "Fallback").

painted.name: LongOpenTerrace
painted.comment: A bare terrace two rooms long open on every side: the 1x2 room for door sets no other room has.

painted.name: WideOpenTerrace
painted.comment: A bare terrace two rooms wide open on every side: the 2x1 room for door sets no other room has.

painted.name: WalledCorner
painted.comment: Rooms with a section (part of the room cut off in the layout), walled off by a low parapet of the castle wall (paint_sections.py): corner, top middle, wide corner or top strip, and their mirrors.

painted.name: WalledLow
painted.comment: Sections at the bottom: corner, bottom middle, wide corner or bottom strip, and their mirrors.

painted.name: WalledSide
painted.comment: Sections at the sides: side middle, tall corner or side strip, and their mirrors.

painted.name: WalledTall
painted.comment: The tall corner at the bottom, and its mirror.

painted.name: LongWalledTop
painted.comment: A 1x2 room with a section at the top: corner, top middle, wide corner or top strip, and their mirrors.

painted.name: LongWalledLow
painted.comment: A 1x2 room with a section at the bottom, and their mirrors.

painted.name: WideWalledA
painted.comment: A 2x1 room with a section (the ids of a 2x1 room come from turning the 1x2 ones, so its painted rooms are not mirrored).

painted.name: WideWalledB
painted.comment: A 2x1 room with a section, the other side.

painted.name: WideWalledC
painted.comment: A 2x1 room with a section at the bottom left.

painted.name: WideWalledD
painted.comment: A 2x1 room with a section at the bottom right.
